note: Per-draw simulated outcomes over the SAME 1500 worlds the parlay leg matrix uses, rounded half-up to integers. A half-point threshold is exact on these values; joint probability within this game is a mask over shared draws, never a product of marginals. Cross-game legs are independent by construction (separate simulations, separate seeds). Rung probabilities published elsewhere are canonical 10,000-draw calibrated values and are not recomputed from this block.
